# harness_platform_idp_integration_catalog (Data Source)

Data source for the Airbyte streams of an IDP integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The streams an Airbyte integration's connector can read, with their sync modes.
data "harness_platform_idp_integration_catalog" "example" {
  integration_id = "servicenow_prod"
  org_id         = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Identifier of the integration.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `streams` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--streams))
- `version` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--streams"></a>
